Class Rectangle

java.lang.Object
construction.Rectangle
All Implemented Interfaces:
Comparable<Rectangle>
public class Rectangle extends Object implements Comparable<Rectangle>
These comments represent an example of JavaDoc Comments in the way your instructor likes to write them. DESCRIPTION This class describes a rectangle representing a location (x, y) in coordinate circles.ball.space, specified to double floating rectangle precision.
